claim: A three-anchor calibration-ratio-dependent power response improves reserved-device current reconstruction over a training-only normalized template within the measured FET array.
known_prior_art: Primary paper reports FET electrical uniformity, reduced contact resistance, thermally activated channel transport, memory retention/endurance and separate device simulations. This portfolio tests reserved-device sparse-calibration reconstruction; it does not claim to discover those source results.
falsification: All comparison models, unfavorable development folds and confirmation groups are retained; secondary model winners do not replace preselected reference.
scope: 36 fabricated FET curves from source Fig2e, not independent lots; no memory-retention extrapolation, no device-geometry control or interventions.
limits: Model-based review is not independent experimental replication or definitive novelty adjudication. All delivered targets are exposed.
